Egyptian Electricity Holding Company
Maintenance Procedures Information System
Maintenance Procedures Information System
 | Communications – Generation | Maintenance Procedures
Document No.: COMS-004-r0 | Equipment: Philips Sopho S1000 PABX, Italian
Issued to: Esna Power Station
Document status: Approved
Date of document approval: 18 January 2009 | Procedure: Annual maintenance
Date of next review: January 2014
Introduction
This document sets out the steps for the annual maintenance of the Philips Sopho S1000 PABX. The first draft of this document was prepared by Eng. Hassan Mousa Hassan at Esna Power Station; the test was carried out on 29 October 2008 by Eng. Ramadan Farrag Ahmed.
Safety Precautions
A work order must be opened | 
Follow the industrial safety and occupational health instructions for the safety of personnel and equipment | 
Tools, Equipment and Instruments Used
Avometer | 
Blower | 
Procedure to be Carried Out
Disconnect the power from the cabinet | 1.
Remove the cards from the cabinet | 2.
Clean the cabinet cards using the blower | 3.
Visually inspect the condition of the cards and replace any faulty one | 4.
Insert the cards into their slots | 5.
Switch on the power | 6.
Check and measure the power supply voltage values as per the table | 7.
